internal.title: High Latency Incident in 'ad' Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body: On 2026-11-08 at 11:21 UTC, a high latency alert was triggered for the 'ad' service. Diagnosis identified high CPU utilization (0.98) causing resource exhaustion, leading to increased p95 latency (1.8s). The mitigation involved disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 11:41 UTC, which resulted in latency recovery to normal levels (0.12s). The incident was resolved without any error injection or deployment issues. Lessons learned include monitoring CPU utilization thresholds closely and having automated flag controls for rapid mitigation.
